title: Name the type
prompt: Return "int", "float", "String" or "other" depending on the type of value.
hints: Chain of if / elif using is.
`if value is int:` ... `elif value is float:` ... `elif value is String:` ... else.

docs.name: value is String
docs.what: true if the value is of that type. Also is int, is float, is bool.
